fields.amenities.0.title: Wifi
fields.amenities.1.title: Television
fields.amenities.2.body:
Radiators are controlled from the wall thermostats.

Please do not adjust or turn off the radiators themselves — everything is controlled from the wall.
fields.amenities.2.title: Heating
fields.amenities.3.body:
Fully equipped kitchen with cooking hob and dishwasher.

Appliance manuals: howdens.fr.
fields.amenities.3.title: Kitchen
fields.amenities.4.body: Nespresso machine, filter coffee maker and kettle in the kitchen.
fields.amenities.4.title: Coffee
fields.amenities.5.body:
The Beko washer-dryer is in the entrance closet. Manual: beko.fr.

Remember to reduce the load for drying: it dries less laundry than it washes at once.
fields.amenities.5.title: Washer-dryer
fields.amenities.6.body:
The living room sofa converts into a sofa bed.

Bedding is stored in the small white cabinets under the seat, facing the sofa.
fields.amenities.6.title: Sofa bed
fields.amenities.7.body:
To get started — coffee capsules and tea (first night), 2 to 3 rolls of toilet paper.

For your entire stay — cotton sheets and towels (hotel equivalent), hair dryer. Cleaning is included.
fields.amenities.7.title: What we provide
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.0: Did you press the padlock after entering your code? It validates the entry — without pressing it, the box won't open.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.1: The box unlocked, but did you pull to the side to open it? Unlocking doesn't open it automatically.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.2: After several incorrect codes, the box goes into safety mode. Wait 1 to 2 minutes without touching it, then try again calmly.
fields.arrival.keybox_help.title: Having trouble opening the key box?
fields.arrival.steps.0.text: You're arriving at 44 rue Roger Radisson, on the Fourvière hill — at the corner of rue Pauline Marie Jaricot, facing Hôtel Fourvière. The building is called « Le Clos de Fourvière ».
fields.arrival.steps.0.title: Find the building
fields.arrival.steps.1.text: The key box is located just to the left of the apartment door.
fields.arrival.steps.1.title: Your door, on the ground floor
fields.arrival.steps.2.code_note: Your code · active until your departure
fields.arrival.steps.2.photo_caption: The key box, to the left of the door
fields.arrival.steps.2.text: Place your palm on the keypad to turn it on, enter your code, then press the padlock. Wait for the beep, then pull to the side to open the box and retrieve your key.
fields.arrival.steps.2.title: The key box
fields.arrival.steps.3.text: The key opens the door. The living room, kitchen and sleeping area are on the ground floor; the 3 bedrooms and bathrooms are on the lower level. Welcome to L'Élégant ✨
fields.arrival.steps.3.title: You're here
fields.checkout_line: windows closed, key in the key box
fields.house_rules.0.text: The living room and kitchen are on the ground floor; the 3 bedrooms and bathrooms are on the lower level, accessed by an internal staircase.
fields.house_rules.0.title: Split-level — bedrooms downstairs
fields.house_rules.1.text: Smoking is prohibited inside. A CO₂ detector triggers an alarm if moved — restoration costs up to €65.
fields.house_rules.1.title: Non-smoking apartment
fields.house_rules.2.text: A decibel detector and camera monitor the hallway (no conversations are recorded).
fields.house_rules.2.title: No parties or gatherings
fields.house_rules.3.text: Please respect this: some guests may have allergies.
fields.house_rules.3.title: No pets allowed
fields.house_rules.4.text: Occupied building — please be considerate of neighbors.
fields.house_rules.4.title: Quiet after 10 PM
fields.luggage.sub_arrival: Nannybag luggage storage at Part-Dieu · from €4.50/day
fields.luggage.sub_departure: Drop off your luggage and enjoy Lyon until your train · from €4.50/day
fields.parking.text.0: Drop-off zone: there's almost always space to unload on rue Roger Radisson, right across from the building.
fields.parking.text.1: Free: parking often available on rue Roger Radisson, rue Jaricot, rue du Cardinal Gerlier, Montée du Télégraphe and Place du 158e RI. Free on public holidays and in August. Paid zones nearby are affordable.
fields.parking.text.2: Very quiet neighborhood, except during the Nuits de Fourvière (Fourvière Nights).
fields.recos.food.0.desc: The bar « Les Collections » and the bistro restaurant « Les Téléphones », right across the street.
fields.recos.food.1.desc: Shaded terrace and dining room with fireplace, 350 m away. Refined bistro cuisine.
fields.recos.food.2.desc: Fine dining restaurant with panoramic views, 700 m away. The wine bar « Phosphore » and its tapas below.
fields.recos.food.4.desc: Authentic Lyonnais bouchon (traditional restaurant), rue du Bœuf in Old Town — about 1.2 km away, or by funicular.
fields.recos.food.5.desc: Large terrace in summer, fondue by the fireplace in winter, 650 m away.
fields.recos.shop.0.desc: Convenience store, 1 rue de la Favorite.
fields.recos.shop.1.desc: Bread and pastries 550 m away, 12 rue de la Favorite.
fields.recos.visit.0.desc: Gallo-Roman museum and ancient theaters, very close by. Theater access is free.
fields.recos.visit.1.desc: Crypt and panoramic views over all of Lyon, about 700 m away. Stunning views from the esplanade.
fields.recos.visit.2.desc: Renaissance district listed as UNESCO heritage, about 1.1 km away via Montée du Gourguillon or funicular. Don't miss the traboules (covered passageways).
fields.recos.visit.3.desc: Bartholdi fountain and City Hall, in the heart of the Presqu'île.
fields.recos.visit.4.desc: Spectacular architecture at the tip of the Presqu'île, varied exhibitions.
fields.recos.visit.5.desc: 5 km riverside stroll. Allow ~15-20 min to come down from the hill (or funicular + metro D).
fields.transport.lines.0.text: Fourvière station (F2) 600 m away or Saint-Just (F1) 400 m away — direct access to Old Town and metro D.
fields.transport.lines.0.title: Funicular & Metro D
fields.transport.lines.1.text: Jaricot stop (line 90) just below; St Alexandre stop (55, C21) 700 m away → Perrache.
fields.transport.lines.1.title: Bus
fields.transport.lines.2.text: Perrache in 15 min (bus C21 or 55); Part-Dieu in 45 min (metro B then D + funicular).
fields.transport.lines.2.title: Train stations
fields.transport.lines.3.text: Rhônexpress to Vaulx-en-Velin La Soie, then metro A → Bellecour, metro D → Old Town and funicular. Uber or taxi possible, similar duration.
fields.transport.lines.3.title: Airport
